title: RAMA Integration into RelGNN: Additive Improvement over SOTA on rel-f1 and rel-amazon
summary: Demo notebook that loads pre-computed experiment results (20 runs: 5 seeds x 2 methods x 2 tasks) comparing RelGNN+sum baseline vs RelGNN+RAMA on rel-f1/driver-position and rel-amazon/item-ltv regression tasks. Reproduces statistical analysis including Cohen's d effect sizes, paired t-tests, Wilcoxon tests, and DerSimonian-Laird random-effects meta-analysis. Generates three visualizations: MAE comparison bar chart, effect size forest plot, and training loss curves. Uses mini_demo_data.json (22KB, curated from full results).
